jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.





Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.




But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a 
BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year
, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.




Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.





What We Offer






Comprehensive Benefits: 
We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.





Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: 
Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.





Wellness: 
We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.





Employee Resource Groups:
 Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.







About Trulioo



Trulioo is the world's leading global identity verification, fraud, and risk management platform. We equip the world's leading companies to fight fraud and financial crime across the entire customer lifecycle, using AI-powered risk intelligence and a unified global data fabric spanning 195+ countries. Backed by top-tier growth equity investors, Trulioo is investing in its Finance function to match the scale and sophistication of the business.





Position Summary



The Corporate Controller is a senior leadership hire and a critical partner to the CFO. This role owns the financial integrity of the business: the accounting infrastructure, the close process, the control environment, and the compliance posture across a dynamic, multi-entity, multi-national organization. You'll run the function with the discipline of a company preparing for a major liquidity event, while building at the pace and prioritization that a scaling business actually requires.




This is not a maintenance role. The right person will build institutional-grade infrastructure on a thoughtful timeline, use AI and automation to run a lean and high-output team, and operate as a genuine business partner alongside FP&A and the CFO. Trulioo is at a stage where the accounting function needs to keep pace with strategic ambition.




This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office).





What You'll Own:





Accounting Operations and Close







General Accounting and Close Process





You'll own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close: accurate, on-time, and improving in efficiency over time. GL management, journal entries, reconciliations, and the full range of technical GAAP accounting that a sophisticated, pre-IPO business requires are foundational to this role. You'll also own the technical accounting policies that govern how the business handles complex areas — equity compensation, capitalized development costs, lease obligations, and others that will evolve as the business grows — and enforce their consistent application across the organization. Beyond the policies themselves, you'll shape the systems and process infrastructure that makes compliance repeatable and scalable.







Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Billing





You'll oversee AR, AP, and billing with a clear view to cash cycle performance. DSO, DPO, and billing accuracy are metrics you track, report on, and manage against. You understand that these functions directly affect liquidity and working capital, and you run them accordingly.







Payroll and Treasury





You'll own payroll operations across jurisdictions, coordinating with HR to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution. On the treasury side, you'll maintain cash visibility, support cash forecasting in close partnership with FP&A, and manage banking relationships and operational cash management.







Tax





You'll oversee global tax compliance across the jurisdictions Trulioo operates in, working with external advisors as necessary. You'll stay ahead of obligations, minimize risk exposure, and build the internal capability needed as the business continues to expand its geographic footprint.










Multi-Entity and International Operations







Multi-Entity Structure and Intercompany





Trulioo operates through a multi-entity corporate structure across multiple countries. You'll manage the intercompany framework, ensure consolidations are clean and well-controlled, and keep the legal entity structure properly maintained from an accounting and compliance standpoint.







Transfer Pricing





You'll own the transfer pricing framework, working with tax advisors to ensure Trulioo's intercompany arrangements are properly documented, defensible, and aligned with evolving international standards. As the business grows, you'll proactively assess where the framework needs to evolve.









Control Environment and Audit Readiness







Internal Controls and Compliance





You'll design and maintain a controls environment that is proportionate to the risk and complexity of the business today, and scalable to the expectations of a public company. You'll identify gaps, close them methodically, and build a roadmap that gets the organization audit-ready for a potential liquidity event on a five-year horizon. Not everything is day one, but everything is planned.







External Audit





You'll own the external audit relationship: managing the process, coordinating deliverables, and ensuring the audit is completed accurately and efficiently. You'll position the business to move from reviewed to audited financials if that transition is required, and eventually to the standard a public company demands.










Strategic Partnership







FP&A Collaboration





The Corporate Controller and the VP of FP&A function as a unit. You'll ensure that actuals are clean, timely, and structured in a way that directly feeds the FP&A team's analysis and reporting. Variance analysis is only as good as the accounting underneath it. You'll close that loop.







Business Partnership and Metrics





You're not here to watch the scoreboard; you're here to help improve it. You'll track the operational and efficiency metrics that reflect accounting function performance, surface cash cycle insights that inform business decisions, and engage with commercial and operational leaders as a credible financial voice. The numbers you produce should create clarity, not just compliance.







M&A Accounting and Integration





You'll support corporate development activity with accounting diligence, purchase price allocation, and post-acquisition integration. You've done this before and understand that integration accounting is where deals either get clean or get complicated. You'll ensure it gets clean.







Audit Committee and Executive Communication





You'll own the Corporate Controller's relationship with the audit committee: preparing materials, presenting financial results and control environment updates, and fielding questions from a sophisticated board audience. This requires more than technical accuracy. You'll translate complex accounting positions, audit findings, and policy changes into clear, well-structured narratives that give the committee the context they need to govern effectively.










Building the Function







AI-First Accounting Function





You'll actively apply AI tools to accounting workflows: automating reconciliations, accelerating close, improving accuracy in high-volume processes, and reducing manual work across the team. This is not aspirational; it's an active expectation. You'll set the standard for how the team works and raise it over time.







Data Architecture and Systems





You'll own the data and systems layer that makes the accounting function analytically useful, not just compliant. That means a chart of accounts structured with intentionality: clean enough to close fast, and logical enough to support product-level and segment-level profitability analysis. You'll ensure transactional data flows are accurate, well-governed, and organized in ways that let FP&A, Rev Ops, and business leaders slice performance by the dimensions that matter. As Trulioo adds products, markets, and entities, you'll keep the underlying data architecture from becoming a liability.







People Leadership





You'll lead a talented accounting team with high standards and a genuine investment in their development. You'll build the team thoughtfully as the business scales, prioritizing talent density over headcount, and shaping the function into one that the organization relies on and respects.









What We're Looking For:





CPA designation and 15+ years of progressive accounting and controllership experience, with meaningful time in high-growth technology businesses. Proficient with US GAAP and working knowledge of IFRS




Deep experience with multi-entity, multi-national accounting structures, including intercompany, consolidation, and transfer pricing




Demonstrated ability to build and scale a controls environment with public-company readiness as a long-term objective




Track record of running a tight, high-quality close process and managing accounting operations across AR, AP, billing, payroll, tax, and treasury




Hands-on experience with M&A accounting, including diligence support, purchase price allocation, and post-acquisition integration




Genuine, demonstrated use of AI and automation tools in accounting workflows; you're not waiting for this to become mainstream




Strong data and systems literacy: you design chart of accounts structures with an analytical purpose, govern transactional data with precision, and build the accounting layer to support product and segment profitability reporting across a multi-dimensional business




Strong operational instincts: you manage by metrics, track cash cycle performance, and treat accounting as a function that directly supports business outcomes




Ability to partner effectively with FP&A: you understand how the accounting function feeds planning and analysis, and you optimize for that relationship




Experience with growth equity-backed companies and familiarity with the reporting and compliance expectations that come with sophisticated investors




Clear, direct communicator who can translate accounting complexity into plain language for business stakeholders and the CFO




A builder with the judgment to pace infrastructure investments appropriately: rigorous about what needs to be done now and practical about what can be sequenced







Interview Process:



At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.


Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:




Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes




Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes




Panel Interview: 60 minutes




Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes







Why Trulioo



Trulioo is at an inflection point. The platform is scaling, the global footprint is expanding, and the business is backed by investors with the conviction to support its ambitions. The Corporate Controller will have direct partnership with the CFO, ownership of a consequential function, and the mandate to build an accounting operation that reflects where this company is going, not just where it has been.





Thriving at Trulioo



At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.




We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.







Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com





If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.




Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.






Privacy Notice



As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Who We’re Looking For



At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.





We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. 
We hire people
 
who want to rewrite them
. And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)





What is ScalePad



At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.





Our mission: help 
MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner)
. Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion.

Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.



But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.





With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.





About The Role



As Corporate Controller, you will own ScalePad's accounting function end to end: financial reporting, tax and audit, treasury, payroll, and equity administration. This is a hands-on role leading a small team: you will be in the work, not just reviewing it. Reporting directly to the CFO, you'll be a true partner in strategic financial decision-making.






This is a critical seat, and we need a true expert to command it. 
Someone who trained in public practice, has run the tax calendar across borders, sat across from auditors and tax authorities, managed treasury, and closed complex multi-entity books. If you know the ins and outs of Canadian and US corporate tax, sales and use tax, SR&ED, transfer pricing, credit facilities, and cross-border structures, this role was written for you.





The complexity is what makes this seat interesting: a private-equity-backed, multi-entity group spanning Canada and the US, consolidated in NetSuite OneWorld across parallel CAD and USD hierarchies under ASPE, with an active acquisition pipeline and regular reporting to our lenders and investor. You'll have a capable small team and strong external advisors behind you. Your job is to lead the function, strengthen it, and scale it.





What You’ll Own



Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:





Financial Reporting & Consolidation. 
Own the monthly close and consolidation across multiple legal entities in two currency hierarchies (CAD and USD), including intercompany eliminations, delivering accurate ASPE financials on a reliable calendar for leadership, lenders, and our private-equity investor.



Audit, Tax & Compliance. 
Lead the annual external audit end to end and own the Canadian and US tax compliance calendar: corporate filings in both countries, cross-border transfer pricing documentation, multi-state US sales and use tax, GST/HST, and SR&ED. Represent the company confidently in tax-authority reviews and audits (CRA and US), directing external advisors so the work gets done right.



Treasury & Banking. 
Own cash management and forecasting across multiple banks, entities, and currencies, wire and FX execution, credit facility administration, covenant compliance, and day-to-day lender relationships.



Revenue & AR Cycle Management. 
Manage and optimize the complete revenue and accounts receivable cycle for our multi-product SaaS business, ensuring precision in revenue recognition across subscription models.



Payroll, Benefits & Equity. 
Oversee payroll across Canadian and US entities on parallel systems, support benefits renewals in both countries, and administer the equity program (cap table, stock-based compensation, and annual valuation cycles).



Controls, Systems & Process Improvement. 
Build the control environment for a scaling multi-entity group: approval matrices, delegation of authority, and documented processes. Maximize our NetSuite investment and keep improving how the function runs; you'll have license to experiment with automation and new tools.



M&A Integration. 
When we acquire, you integrate: onboarding new entities into the consolidation, aligning charts of accounts, and folding acquired operations into the close, tax, and treasury cadence.



Leadership & Team Development. 
Work hands-on alongside a small team, mentoring and developing them while building a function where knowledge is shared and no process depends on a single person.





What we’re looking for



We care about what you can do more than where you’ve done it. However, experience in the following areas will help you hit the ground running in this role:




This is a senior, high-trust role, so some things are non-negotiable.


Canadian CPA designation (Chartered Professional Accountant). CPA, CA welcomed; a US CPA alongside is a plus.


Public practice foundation at a Big Four or large national accounting firm, with the audit or tax depth that comes from it.


10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years in a SaaS or software environment managing multiple entities.


Experience owning a controllership function (or clearly operating at that level) with a small team, staying hands-on in the detail while leading.


Multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation in a Canada/US cross-border structure. This is the core of the role, and we'll ask about it.


Deep knowledge of ASPE and SaaS revenue recognition.


Proven track record leading external audits and managing tax compliance across jurisdictions, including US sales and use tax.





Strong assets





Direct experience responding to CRA (or IRS/state) reviews and audits.


Hands-on treasury experience: cash forecasting, banking platforms, FX, credit facilities.


Experience with SR&ED and other government programs, transfer pricing, and corporate insurance programs.


Strong NetSuite (or similar ERP) proficiency; implementation or optimization experience.


M&A and entity-integration experience.


Comfort directing external advisors (audit, tax, valuation) and knowing what to outsource versus own.





How you work





Meticulous and deadline-driven: closes, filings, and lender deliverables land on time, every time.


Calm and credible under scrutiny: comfortable being the company's voice with auditors, tax authorities, banks, and our investor.


An owner's mentality: you take responsibility for the whole function, document as you go, and never let a known issue sit.


A clear, direct communicator who can explain complex accounting and tax matters to non-accountants.








Perks



ScalePad offers our employees a blend of purpose, growth, and genuinely great perks.





Everyone’s an owner.
 Share in our success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and RRSP matching.



Support for growing families.
 Parental leave programs are in place to support you and your family when it matters most.



Structured mentorship with builders.
 Join opt-in mentorship programs and learn directly from founders and senior leaders who’ve scaled multiple SaaS ventures and spent decades in the MSP industry.



Invest in your growth every year.
 Access an annual professional development budget to level up your skills, your career, and your impact.



Set yourself up with great tools.
 Work with brand new, top-of-the-line hardware and equipment so you can do your best work, whether you’re at home or in one of our hubs.



Modern ways of working.
 Roles at ScalePad are structured as remote or hybrid, with hub locations in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix. Specific work models are outlined in each posting.



Support for hybrid life.
 Receive a monthly stipend to help you create an effective hybrid or remote work environment.



Well-being and time to recharge.
 Take care of yourself with 100% employer-paid benefits.





Before You Apply



This is a full-time role for those who are eligible to work in Canada or the United States. We thank all applicants for taking the time to apply, but only candidates who make it to the next stage will be contacted.




Note on AI Use
: ScalePad uses AI technology to support certain administrative aspects of our hiring process, such as transcription, note-taking, and interview documentation. These tools are strictly used to assist our team and have no influence on candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.






No recruiters, please.
